defects_found_in_main_run.when: 29 Oct 2026, after types 1-10 and 9 of 25 type-11 batches of the first E44 main run (interim summary)
defects_found_in_main_run.first_run_parts: results/archive/E44_parts_pre-body-fix/ (development output; not used for results)

defects.name: body geometry at path corners
defects.what: the vehicle body was drawn backwards from the front along the front's current heading; past a sharp corner it swung sideways into the other lane and registered false contacts
defects.fix: the body follows the path: body centre and the two discs at s - L/2 and s - L/2 +- off along the centreline (lunarsim/atc/encounter.py _body); run time +38 %

defects.name: type-6 builder: crossings without junction control
defects.what: the random straight roads through the landing zone crossed with no junction control (no R10 tile), so contacts occurred at unmanaged crossings, not under R5
defects.fix: an R10 junction tile at every crossing, half-length (W + 1 m) / sin(angle) + 2 m (lunarsim/atc/encounter_types.py _crossing_tiles)

genuine_finding.name: type 9 dead stop
genuine_finding.rule: R1 (RSS keep distance): d_min assumes the leader brakes at most at B_MAX = 0.8 m/s2; a fault stops a vehicle instantly, so a same-direction follower inside the single-lane segment loses its margin
genuine_finding.status: reported as a result of E44, not corrected; a dead-stop margin variant is future work (not run)

defects_found_in_main_run.re_runs: the fuzzer-free violating encounters were re-run because they are deterministic (a random fuzzer draws from a batch-shaped random stream); the fixes are in the final run of all 12 types at the same n

change_9.when: 29-30 Oct 2026, E44 rerun: the first type-6 pass after change 8, then change 9 and its correction

defect.name: type-6 builder start state
defect.what: with the change-8 junction tiles, a vehicle could start within its stopping distance of a crossing tile (e.g. 0.6 m before it at 2.78 m/s), so it entered the tile without a grant
defect.fix: no start inside a crossing tile or within stopping distance (mu 0.3) + 20 m of one; such a start is moved just past the tile, repeated for the next tile (lunarsim/atc/encounter_types.py _crossing_tiles)
defect.fixtures_identity_method: by construction: the fixtures hold the first 600 steps of each replay, and no change-9 code path except the type-6 builder enters them (the gap metric and the stall classifier are not in the fixtures, and termination cannot occur within 600 steps). A direct byte comparison with the earlier files was not possible: gzip stored a timestamp and the files were regenerated in place. Fixtures are now written with mtime 0; two regenerations are byte-identical; the parity test passes.

metric_change.name: same-lane test for the gap metric
metric_change.definition: the D0 violation and the near-miss gap count a leader pair only if both vehicles are on the same path, or on the same piece line in the same direction (heading within 0.001 rad, line offset within 0.05 m); the shield's own leader test stays at 30 deg and 1.5 m
metric_change.min_crossing_angle_note: the type-6 builder draws road directions uniformly, so two roads can cross at any angle; hence road identity rather than a heading test

classification_defect.name: stall check: held at a closed zone counted only within 1 m of the line
classification_defect.what: a vehicle held by a closure that had stopped more than ~1 m before the zone line was not counted as held, and any stalled vehicle with an ungranted group counted as 'waiting for a grant', even when that group lay far beyond the zone line; all 202 type-6 'deadlocks' were such closure holds at R = 1 km
classification_defect.fix: held at a closed zone = the zone line is the binding stop line; waiting for a grant = the entry of the ungranted group is the binding stop line, within request distance (lunarsim/atc/encounter.py)

changes_by_type.5: deadlock flag only (915 rows, nearly all fuzzer encounters, which are not counted)
changes_by_type.6: deadlock flag; the stall test also ends encounters, so end time, steps and proposals changed in 355 encounters (min_sep in 40, interventions in 25); violations unchanged (0)

remaining_type6_deadlocks.mechanism: a crossing lies at the zone boundary: a vehicle held at the zone line stops inside the crossing tile it holds, and a vehicle that must exit the closing zone through that crossing cannot; no rule keeps a vehicle out of a junction whose far side is a hold point (R3's exit check covers bays only)

variant_dropped.name: 6_request_rule
variant_dropped.status: no mechanism; not reported; files archived
